name: Link Inspector & Repair
description: Scans and repairs legacy REDCap image/file links in project configuration, system settings, and Community Sites, and relocates cross-project file links.

authors.name: Günther Rezniczek
authors.institution: St. Elisabethgruppe GmbH - Marien Hospital Herne | Klinikum der Ruhr-Universität Bochum

project-settings.name: Done with LIR legacy link Control Center scans
project-settings.description: Exclude this project from future Control Center project-configuration scans and hide it from cached project lists. Project scans and repairs remain available.

project-settings.name: Allow cross-project e-document link repairs
project-settings.description: Disabled by default. Enable only for intentional links copied from another project. The link must still use the configured REDCap host and have an exact valid document hash for the e-document's owning project.

system-settings.name: Force cross-project e-document link repairs for all projects
system-settings.description: Disabled by default. When enabled, this Control Center setting overrides the project setting and permits verified legacy links to reference an e-document owned by another project. The configured REDCap host and exact document hash are still required.
